subject.title: [Feature]: Option to skip tool list text in system prompt (reduce duplication)

question: Should OpenClaw add a supported default-off agent/default config contract for suppressing the human-readable Tooling list, or should this reduction stay inside the broader tool-overhead design?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested fix creates a supported prompt/config contract in an area where repository policy keeps config surface high-bar.

options.title: Add Scoped Opt-In Config
options.body: Implement a narrow option that omits only the Tooling list and keeps callable schemas, prompt guidance, diagnostics, docs, and tests intact.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Token Work
options.body: Keep this issue open as linked context while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/14785 owns the broader schema and context-overhead design.

options.title: Reject New Config Surface
options.body: Decide that existing Tool Search, code mode, and broader prompt optimizations are sufficient, then close this direction explicitly.

recommendation.title: Add Scoped Opt-In Config
recommendation.body: Implement a narrow option that omits only the Tooling list and keeps callable schemas, prompt guidance, diagnostics, docs, and tests intact.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior issue review and central prompt/tool-definition history make steipete the strongest routing candidate for this product/config choice.
